Proved reconstruction, deformation, virtual-class, and integrality results are kept distinct from conjectural GW/DT, wall-crossing, BPS-vanishing, and vertex correspondences. accepted_units.title: Design a compactification by localizing the discarded defect
accepted_units.why_material: The source compares representations by what pathology each introduces, then replaces freely wandering zero-dimensional structure with a finite cokernel forced to lie on a pure one-dimensional support. This is a reusable semantic move: preserve the main object, expose the defect as separate data, and constrain that defect to the locus where it belongs rather than canceling it only at the generating-function level.
accepted_units.context_note: Source-grounded in the introduction. The stable-pair definition and claimed virtual-class construction are developed later; equivalence with GW and reduced DT theories is explicitly conjectural. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: arrows, subscripts, and displayed complexes have PDF-to-text damage, so exact formulas require the preserved PDF. Representation limit: the mechanism is expressed with sheaves, sections, supports, and two-term complexes, not as a representation-free theorem. Applicability limit: the virtual-class motivation is specific to nonsingular projective threefolds and purity of one-dimensional sheaves; arbitrary moduli problems need not admit the same repair.

accepted_units.title: Use purity to turn generic generation into support equality and finite-defect reconstruction
accepted_units.why_material: Large-parameter stability collapses to two semantic conditions: purity of the carrier and a section with zero-dimensional cokernel. Purity then forbids a hidden lower-dimensional subobject, forces the section and sheaf to have the same support, and makes dualization plus inverse image a classification/reconstruction procedure. The reusable pattern is to combine generic agreement with exclusion of lower-dimensional defects to upgrade generic data to global structural control.
accepted_units.context_note: The limiting criterion, support result, exact sequence, and fixed-support characterization are proved in the source. The characterization depends on a Cohen-Macaulay curve and ideals supported at finitely many points. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: several inclusions, direct limits, and Hom expressions are visibly damaged; their exact types should be checked against the PDF before reuse. Representation limit: the proof uses coherent sheaves, annihilators, purity, dual Hom, and inverse images. Applicability limit: the argument requires purity and Cohen-Macaulay one-dimensional support; without them, lower-dimensional subobjects can survive and the injections or reconstruction can fail.

accepted_units.title: Prove a richer derived encoding is lossless by canonical recovery
accepted_units.why_material: The pair is encoded as a two-term complex, but the source does not merely assert that the new representation is convenient: it proves a unique canonical map to the structure sheaf, recovers the cone and the original section, and concludes that quasi-isomorphism exactly matches pair isomorphism. This is a reusable standard for abstraction: before exploiting a richer representation, prove that the intended object can be canonically reconstructed from it.
accepted_units.context_note: Proposition 1.21 is proved from exact triangles, Ext-sheaf vanishing, and the uniqueness up to scalars of the relevant map. No information-loss claim beyond the stated stable-pair setting is made. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: triangle arrows and Ext superscripts are partially degraded, though the proposition and reconstruction narrative remain readable. Representation limit: losslessness is only up to isomorphism/quasi-isomorphism and depends on the standard structure sheaf term and cohomological placement. Applicability limit: arbitrary complexes or pairs outside the purity/codimension hypotheses need not admit a unique recovery map or a sheaf-valued cone.

accepted_units.title: Change representation to shorten deformation-obstruction amplitude
accepted_units.why_material: The direct deformation theory of pairs is not suitable for a virtual class, while the lossless fixed-determinant complex representation has trace-free deformation data. The source proves agreement of deformations to all nilpotent orders, reconstructs every fixed-determinant deformation as a pair, removes scalar directions by trace, and uses duality to concentrate the relevant complex in two degrees. The generic move is to transport a moduli problem to an equivalent representation where nuisance symmetries split off and obstruction amplitude becomes manageable.
accepted_units.context_note: The all-order deformation equivalence, two-term trace-free complex, perfect obstruction theory, virtual class, and deformation invariance are presented as proved results, with cited foundational inputs. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: long derived formulas, degree shifts, trace-free notation, and a diagram are degraded; exact proof reuse requires the PDF and cited foundations. Representation limit: the transfer uses perfect complexes, fixed determinant, trace splitting at rank one, Serre duality, and Atiyah/Kodaira-Spencer classes. Applicability limit: it relies on threefold dimension, codimension support, trivial determinant, fineness of the moduli problem, and absence of nontrivial automorphisms; higher-rank variants are explicitly said not to follow immediately.

accepted_units.title: Model wall crossing as reversal of extension direction
accepted_units.why_material: The source decomposes an object into a curve-bearing piece and a maximal finite-support piece, observes that one extension direction destabilizes at a phase wall, and proposes that the reverse extension direction describes the stable objects on the other side. This gives a compact structural explanation for a convolution formula: enumerate all ways the same stable factors can be reassembled after their phase order changes.
accepted_units.context_note: The entire wall-crossing interpretation is explicitly conjectural: the required general counting theory and stability conditions were not available in the stated setting. The exact triangles are source-grounded strategic evidence, not a proved correspondence. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: phase formulas, triangles, and Euler-pairing notation are partially damaged but the extension reversal is readable. Representation limit: the account is phrased in a derived category with shifted zero-dimensional sheaves and stability phases. Applicability limit: it assumes the postulated stability condition, primitive distinct classes, suitable virtual counts, and control of automorphisms; it must not be presented as established wall crossing for arbitrary categories.

accepted_units.title: Recover an expansion by separating polar data from regular coefficients
accepted_units.why_material: A Laurent series is uniquely decomposed in a structured basis by using positive-index terms to match the finite polar part and nonpositive-index terms with successively increasing vanishing order to recover the regular part. An induction on divisibility then removes multiple-cover contributions before applying the same decomposition. This is a generic canonicalization move: split qualitatively different asymptotic data, use a triangular basis on each part, and recurse along a well-founded structural measure.
accepted_units.context_note: Existence, uniqueness, and high-index vanishing of the formal coefficients are proved. The stronger negative-genus vanishing and the resulting finite-effectivity statements are explicitly conjectural/conditional, marked by the source. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: the basis formulas and indices suffer superscript and layout damage; exact coefficients require PDF verification. Representation limit: the mechanism depends on a chosen Laurent-series coordinate, inversion symmetry, and divisibility-indexed multiple-cover basis. Applicability limit: unique formal expansion alone does not prove geometric meaning, integrality, negative-index vanishing, or rationality; finite reconstruction here depends on the separate vanishing conjecture.

accepted_units.title: Transfer integrality through a unitriangular change of coordinates
accepted_units.why_material: The source relates counting coefficients to proposed BPS coefficients by an integer triangular transformation whose diagonal entries are one, giving equivalence of integrality at minimal degree. It then isolates the current-class contribution and treats all other factors by induction on degree. This is a reusable semantic principle: a unitriangular integral coordinate change preserves integral structure, and a filtration lets nonlinear lower-order contributions be discharged inductively.
accepted_units.context_note: The equivalence of integrality is Theorem 3.20 and does not require the negative-genus vanishing conjecture. Its later interpretation as matching Gromov-Witten/BPS integrality additionally invokes conjectural correspondences. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: exponent, product, and coefficient notation is damaged in places; the triangular/unit-diagonal proof remains textually clear but exact series identities need checking. Representation limit: the proof uses formal exponentials, Laurent coefficients, a very-ample-degree filtration, and the chosen basis. Applicability limit: integrality transfer requires integer off-diagonal coefficients, unit diagonal, finite dependence at each filtered stage, and a well-founded degree; those properties cannot be assumed for an arbitrary basis change.

accepted_units.title: Detect hidden nonreduced structure through tangent and localization behavior
accepted_units.why_material: A moduli space appears set-theoretically to be a familiar smooth space, but the predicted invariant has the wrong sign. The source identifies a first-order thickening along a locus, verifies larger tangent spaces there, and shows that localization weights detect the extra infinitesimal dimension. The reusable diagnostic is that agreement of points and strata does not determine scheme structure; tangent data and invariant-sensitive probes can expose nilpotent directions.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a concrete local-curve calculation, not a general theorem about all moduli spaces. The source reports the deformation and localization computation as established in the example. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: some projective-space and series coefficients are garbled, so numerical reproduction requires the PDF. Representation limit: detection uses Zariski tangent dimensions and torus-fixed virtual localization, not merely topology. Applicability limit: a discrepancy in an invariant is only a prompt to inspect nonreduced structure; localization conclusions require the stated torus action, isolated fixed points, and the relevant obstruction theory.

accepted_units.title: Separate support-local contributions from ambient roaming defects
accepted_units.why_material: For an infinitesimally isolated support, stable pairs reduce to divisors on that support and their obstruction bundle is expressed in intrinsic and restricted ambient data, producing a contribution valid across ambient geometries satisfying the same isolation condition. The contrast with ideal-sheaf theory identifies why locality fails there: zero-dimensional pieces can roam throughout the ambient space. The generic move is to locate exactly which degrees of freedom remain attached to the support and which probe the ambient object.
accepted_units.context_note: The local contribution is calculated for a nonsingular embedded curve under infinitesimal isolation and stated to agree with the predicted enumerative correspondence. The locality claim is conditional on those geometric hypotheses, not universal. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: the obstruction exact sequence, diagram, Chern-root products, and generating formulas are degraded; precise calculations require PDF consultation. Representation limit: the mechanism uses symmetric powers, obstruction bundles, Serre duality, and virtual localization/intersection theory. Applicability limit: smoothness, rank-one local freeness on the curve, incidence isolation, and vanishing of the relevant normal deformation space are essential; singular or moving supports may not localize this way.

accepted_units.title: Translate torus-fixed geometry into asymptotic partitions and finite-length module subobjects
accepted_units.why_material: Torus-fixed subschemes become monomial ideals and three-dimensional partitions; outgoing two-dimensional partitions determine a unique minimal Cohen-Macaulay support, while extra finite length measures deviation from it. Stable pairs with that support are then recast as finite-length invariant submodules of an explicit quotient module. The comparison reveals a structural change: combinatorial fixed subschemes are isolated, but fixed submodules can form positive-dimensional components whose Euler characteristics enter the count.
accepted_units.context_note: The monomial/partition dictionary, minimal support, and module characterization are presented as source-grounded. Equality of normalized DT and stable-pair vertices is explicitly conjectural in the three-leg case, with proofs only noted for one- and two-leg cases. Novelty unconfirmed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Extraction limit: partition arrows, quotient modules, and vertex formulas are heavily damaged; exact algebra and normalization require the PDF. Representation limit: the translation depends on a diagonal torus action, monomial ideals, coordinate localizations, and finite-length invariant submodules. Applicability limit: non-toric geometries or non-fixed objects lack this partition model, and counting components by Euler characteristic does not by itself prove the conjectural vertex correspondence.

ecosystem_findings.summary: Within this source, decomposition appears in several materially different roles: carrier versus finite defect, polar versus regular series data, primitive versus lower-degree contributions, and minimal toric support versus finite-length deviation. This strengthens the source-only case that decomposition/canonical-form probes should test what the pieces mean and why reconstruction is unique. Corpus novelty is unconfirmed.

The source ties equivalence of representations to exact triangles and then exploits that derived representation to control deformations, split trace directions, shorten obstruction amplitude, and conjecturally reverse extensions across a wall. This is source-grounded support for testing obstruction as a property changed or exposed by representation, not merely a named formalism. Corpus novelty is unconfirmed.

Canonicality is operational in the source: defects are constrained to their natural support, the original pair is recovered from a unique map out of its complex, series coefficients are forced by triangular asymptotics, and outgoing partitions determine a unique minimal support. This strengthens a source-only saturation probe for uniqueness-through-reconstruction. Corpus novelty is unconfirmed.

remaining_meaningful_material: No additional unit was accepted after complete source inspection. Meaningful but unretained material includes the detailed GIT inequalities and degree-zero specialization; definitions of GW, DT, stable-pair, insertion, equivariant, and relative theories; conjectural partition-function equalities and BPS vanishing consequences; formula-heavy local and three-leg computations; and future foundational directions. These passages remain useful source context, but extracting them as separate agnostic units would either duplicate retained mechanisms, depend on damaged formulas and specialized enumerative notation, or overstate conjectural claims. Novelty of both retained and unretained mechanisms is unconfirmed.
